zvjjzn0d.baseName: Ark Mat 70cm Artificial Wreath - Vintage Sage
zvjjzn0d.variantName: Ark Mat 70cm Artificial Wreath - Vintage Sage
zvjjzn0d.sourceDescription: Bring a seasonal touch to your home with a beautiful artificial decorative wreath, available in a choice of summer, autumn, winter and Christmas designs. Simply select your preferred seasonal style to create the perfect look for your home. Ideal for decorating front doors, porches, walls, windows, hallways and other areas around the home, these versatile artificial wreaths are an easy way to refresh your décor throughout the year. Choose a bright and colourful summer design, warm autumnal style, elegant winter decoration or festive Christmas wreath to suit the season. Designed with decorative artificial flowers, foliage and seasonal details, these wreaths offer the look of natural seasonal decoration without the maintenance required by fresh flowers and foliage. They can be enjoyed year after year as part of your seasonal decorations. Perfect for everyday home décor as well as Christmas decorating, seasonal celebrations, parties and special occasions, these artificial wreaths make a simple and attractive addition to your home. Please note that each seasonal option is a separate design. Please select your preferred summer, autumn, winter or Christmas wreath from the available variations. For decorative use only. Keep the wreath away from open flames, naked flames, candles, fireplaces, heaters and other sources of heat, as the materials may melt or ignite. Do not place the wreath near fire or expose it to excessive heat. Ensure the wreath is securely attached to a suitable surface to prevent it from falling. Take care when handling and hanging the product to avoid injury from any sharp edges, wires or fixing components. Keep packaging materials and small parts away from children to prevent potential choking hazards. Inspect the wreath before use and do not use it if any parts are damaged or broken. If adding decorative lights, ensure they are suitable for the intended use and follow the manufacturer's safety instructions. Retain these safety instructions for future reference. Ark Mat, The Storage Centre, West Park, Wellington, TA21 9AD, United Kingdom
